patches.title: Start at Countertop One
patches.principle: Begin every task by navigating to countertop 1 to initiate a systematic search of open surfaces.
patches.when_to_apply: At the start of a new task when location of target is unknown.

patches.title: Immediate Transformation After Pickup
patches.principle: After picking up the target object, go directly to the appropriate transformation appliance and use it.
patches.when_to_apply: Immediately after acquiring the target object, before any other actions.

patches.title: Direct Placement After Transformation
patches.principle: After transforming the object, go directly to the destination and place it without any detours.
patches.when_to_apply: After completing the transformation step and before any other exploration.
